releases.title: The Halloween Update
releases.summary: Halloween week, a Buddy who learns alongside you, and new ways to make him your own.

slides.title: Halloween week
slides.text: Until October 31, Buddy's corner turns spooky: a witch hat, a candy pail, a spider on its web, bats, and a little skit every couple of minutes. It switches off by itself on November 1.

slides.title: A sidekick that learns
slides.text: With watching on, Buddy learns your apps, picks his own reactions and makes up lines about what you're doing. Health check-ins nudge you to move and eat. Option-click Buddy to choose what he watches.

scene.line: YouTube for the third time today.

slides.title: 63 skins
slides.text: Right-click Buddy and pick Skin. Try an outfit, a costume, or Surprise me. Your choice stays on after a restart.

slides.title: Click what Buddy says
slides.text: Click Buddy's speech bubble to open the chat on that line. You can pick up the conversation right where Buddy left off.

slides.title: Text Buddy from your phone
slides.text: Pair Telegram in the setup wizard, then ask Buddy about your usage while you're away. Your Mac needs to be awake to answer.

messages.text: Example: 42% of your weekly plan used.
Anytime. I've got my eye on it!

slides.title: What your Claude use is worth
slides.text: Click the API value row to pick a period, from this session to all time. See what your use would cost at API prices, how it compares with your plan, and a fun everyday comparison. These numbers are examples.
